newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Treu sets dates for metalworkers' talks.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Treu sets dates for metalworkers' talks.

text.p: Italian Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said on Monday that trades unions and employers involved in a long-running dispute in the metalworkers and engineering sector would be invited formally to hold talks after January 7.
He also said "something has emerged" from a cabinet meeting on Monday that might help resolve the dispute.
"After New Year's Day, I will first have informal meetings, as early as January 2 or 3," he told reporters.
"From the 7th there will be a formal invitation to reopen negotiations. (Italian employers association) Federmeccanica is willing and I hope that this is the right time," he added.
When reporters made the point that Federmeccanica had expressed its willingness to listen to new ideas, Treu replied: "I too am willing to hear new ideas."
Talks between unions and management over the renewal of contracts in the sector, which accounts for some 40 percent of manufacturing output in Italy, have dragged on for months.
